articles.title: 'Very special day': Kawhi Leonard receives warm welcome during Raptors' re-debut in pre-season

articles.title: U.S. court denies bail to alleged Tumbler Ridge shooting conspirator James Bryant
articles.summary: SEATTLE — The suspect who allegedly colluded online with the killer before the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., was denied bail on Tuesday in a Federal Court in Seattle, Wash.
